verdict.rationale: Dynadot is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar, and its core product (domain registration through registry relationships) is inherently a hosted, accredited service, so self-hosting it is a category error rather than a missing feature. The evidence describes the API, MCP server, reseller/WHMCS integrations and an API sandbox, but none of these is a self-hostable deployment of the product. Nothing in the pack shows a self-hosted edition that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
